description: Unofficial Fabric addon that fixes Litematica and MaLiLib rendering with Iris shaders (Minecraft 26.3)

mods.name: Schematic Shader Fix
mods.description: Unofficial addon that fixes schematic rendering of Litematica and the MaLiLib overlay lines while an Iris shader pack is active. Not affiliated with the Litematica or MaLiLib authors.

releases.notes:
- Fix a memory leak on every dimension change and shader reload while an Iris shader pack is
  active. Iris caches the pipelines of its shader programs and never clears that cache, so each
  destroyed Iris pipeline stayed in memory. The cache is now cleared after Iris destroys a pipeline.

Requires Litematica 0.29.1+, MaLiLib 0.30.2+ and Iris 1.11.6+.

releases.notes:
- Fix water, stained glass and other translucent schematic blocks being invisible while an Iris
  shader pack is active. Litematica's translucent pipelines now use the Iris terrain translucent
  shader instead of the Sodium one, which expects a different vertex format.

Requires Litematica 0.29.1+, MaLiLib 0.30.2+ and Iris 1.11.6+.

releases.notes:
First release for Minecraft 26.3.

- Fix schematic blocks stretching into huge "exploding" walls while an Iris shader pack is active.
  Schematic meshes are now always built in the vertex format Iris expects and get rebuilt when
  shaders are toggled.
- Fix diagonal "X" lines on the MaLiLib schematic overlay outlines while a shader pack is active.

Requires Litematica 0.29.1+, MaLiLib 0.30.2+ and Iris 1.11.6+.
